title: DMT laser diffraction shows the same symbols

tellings.quote: they found that everybody was seeing these same symbols when they did Shine a laser a certain way

plain: People on DMT, a powerful psychedelic drug, all saw the same symbols when a laser was shone a certain way, or so a man named Danny Jones told a guest named Randy Anderson. Anderson, who says he saw alien technology at a military base, passes it on to Michels: "everybody was seeing these same symbols." If true, it would hint that the drug opens onto something shared and real, not just private visions.
